fdea1b70f6.q: What chicken dish does Chef Keaka Lee recommend at Kapa Hale to understand his cooking?
fdea1b70f6.a: Chef Lee recommends their chicken dish, which features chicken from Ludovico Farm in North Shore that is raised using Korean practices. The dish includes a homemade kalamansi kosho made with kalamansi limes, salt, and Hawaiian chilies, plus a salsa verde. The cooking technique is based on Jonathan Waxman's roast chicken from Barbuto in New York City—brined, spatchcocked, and finished on the grill for a charred skin. The focus is on highlighting the quality of the chicken itself rather than the sauce.

5cde06b701.q: Why did Chef Keaka Lee incorporate soy sauce into a creme brulee dessert at Kapa Hale?
5cde06b701.a: Chef Lee started experimenting with soy sauce in dessert about five years ago when an event asked him to pair something with natto. He created a pineapple upside-down soy sauce cake, and the caramelization brought the flavors together in a way that inspired him. He realized no one had done this before and decided to explore soy sauce in desserts. At Kapa Hale, he created a maple soy sauce creme brulee topped with kaki mochi, a Hawaiian snack also called bubu arare.

bbc8f21553.q: What Hawaiian ingredient did Chef Keaka Lee feature on Hawaiian Airlines' 2026 first-class menu?
bbc8f21553.a: Chef Lee featured ulu, or breadfruit, on the Hawaiian Airlines first-class menu beginning in 2026. He has been working with Hawaiian Airlines since 2022, with their first first-class menu launching in 2024. The Hawaii Ulu Co-op processes breadfruit into flour and baker's ripe (peeled and steamed) to make it easier for restaurants and consumers to use. Lee notes this is one of his proud moments, helping to promote a local Hawaii ingredient to airline passengers.

29a077a351.q: How did opening Kapa Hale during the COVID-19 pandemic change Chef Keaka Lee's definition of success?
29a077a351.a: Chef Lee signed his lease in November 2019, his daughter Astoria was born in January 2020, and the pandemic began in February-March 2020. He approached his lawyer to draft an exit clause in case they had to close before opening. Today, his definition of success prioritizes being a great father and family man over being a great chef. He now takes time away from the business to pick up his daughter from school, attend her hula practice, or go to her soccer games—something he would not have done ten years earlier when focused solely on building his career.

d93af1e8e6.q: What did Chef Mike Anthony teach Chef Keaka Lee about managing younger cooks?
d93af1e8e6.a: Chef Anthony pulled Chef Lee aside after hearing him complain that younger cooks were not the same and did not want to work hard, unlike his generation which endured having pots and pans thrown at them. Anthony challenged this attitude, explaining that Lee could not be like everyone else and ignore the struggles of the younger generation. This moment shifted Lee's perspective on how to lead and mentor new cooks at his restaurant.
